profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ DoorDash
profile.summary: Hands-on software engineer and engineering manager with over 12 years of experience writing code, leading/growing teams, and teaching software engineering.

positions.title: Engineering Lead
positions.description:
SevenRooms was acquired by DoorDash.

I was an individual contributor manager at SevenRooms, spending 70% of my time writing code and 30% of my time managing three teams of engineers (API Infrastructure, Partnerships, and Point of Sale Integrations). On the management side, I was responsible for biweekly one on ones, roadmap planning, leading sprint ceremonies, and creating processes to increase productivity. Over the course of two years, my teams increased their velocity by 65%. As an individual contributor, I ended my time being the #10 contributor out of 80+ engineers.

positions.title: Engineering Team Lead
positions.description: I led a team of 8 backend engineers and coded features to build the Venmo Teen Card. I was also responsible for creating epics, breaking down features into stories, assigning work, and leading all sprint ceremonies. I was in frequent communication with product & design and represented my team to higher-level executives.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: I developed many features for the Venmo Credit Card (VCC) as a backend engineer (Django, Python, Kafka). Some notable features include deploying VCC as it's own microservice (reduced merge times by 99%+), all account servicing screens (these pages average 300 requests/second with minimal latency), and building functionality such as reporting a card as lost or stolen within the app (saves business over $500k annually).

positions.title: Director of Education
positions.description:
As Director of Education and employee #1 at Code Platoon, I wore a great number of hats. I taught students, managed a team of 16 instructional staff, was responsible for creating new programs, and evangelized our mission to the community.

Achievements:
- Taught over 350 military veterans / spouses with over 93% of students receiving offers in software development
- Presented workshops for corporate trainings and technology events, including: Deloitte, Groupon, Wounded Warriors, University of Chicago Booth School of Business, Denver Startup Week, Tech Inclusion Chicago, Chicago Veteran Developers, Tech Jobs Chicago, and MilSpouse Coders
- Created multiple bootcamp curriculums in DevOps, Ruby on Rails with ReactJS & Python, and Django with ReactJS

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
During my time at DRW, I was tasked with automating several tedious manual processes for the Facilities team to increase productivity. Using Python/Flask, I developed a chatbot that hooked into Mattermost,  an open-source messaging platform that reached out to a number of Rails 5 applications that I wrote. The Facilities team saw a 90% decrease in the amount of time that they had to spend on those manual processes.

I also created reports reconciling discrepancies between two services using Oracle, Python, and Microsoft Reporting Services.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a Software Engineer at OneMain,  I worked primarily in the RoR ecosystem (Rails 4, Ruby 2.2.4, Postgres, Slim) with a sprinkling of Javascript (vanilla and jQuery). I was the top contributor for 40% of the most widely used repositories on my team and in the top 3 contributors for 60% of the other repositories.

This role married dev and business roles as I was in frequent contact with the marketing and project management department. I also got the privilege of mentoring a number of junior developers which included a large transfer of knowledge through pair programming, frequent code reviews, and being a first point of technical contact.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: While at Groupon, I worked in the RoR ecosystem (Rails 3, Ruby 1.8.7). This software engineering role married being a web developer, database engineer, and business analyst all into one. My team was authorized and responsible for updating/maintaining customer records in the production database while also creating tools for customer service representatives to hit the database using APIs. We were essentially trying to fully automate our team's responsibilities. During my time there, we were able to build a number of tools that brought down our need to SSH into the database by 75%.

positions.title: Special Education Teacher
positions.description: Through Teach for America, I worked as a Special Education teacher in the Chicago Public Schools system at a low-income high school called Harper High School. Harper received national attention when it was featured in a two-week segment of NPR's "This American Life." While at Harper, I taught 5 classes of special education Algebra I, Algebra II, Pre-Calculus, and Trignometry. My students on average scored 50-60% higher on state standardized tests than the state average.
